delivery.en: Parcels: a neighbour, Poșta Moldovei, or a pickup point
delivery.zh: 包裹交給鄰居，或到摩爾多瓦郵局、取件點領取

readback.en: Numbers may go in groups of three; amounts in Moldovan lei, not Romanian lei
readback.zh: 電話可三位一組唸；金額用摩爾多瓦列伊，不是羅馬尼亞列伊

fraud.en: A fake Poșta Moldovei parcel text, or a bank code or transfer request, is a scam
fraud.zh: 假摩爾多瓦郵局包裹簡訊，或銀行要驗證碼、要你轉帳的都是詐騙

habits.en: Romanian; follow if the caller switches to Russian. tu / dumneavoastră. Not Romanian bank-app names.
habits.zh: 用羅馬尼亞語；對方改俄語就跟。朋友 tu，其餘 dumneavoastră。不用羅馬尼亞銀行 App 名。

stall_local.en: Get stuck on the bank app spinning, missing glasses, or the ID card not to hand.
stall_local.zh: 卡在銀行 App 一直轉、找不到眼鏡，或證件不在手上。

reason.zh: 羅馬尼亞銀行支付 App

talk_style_diff.en: Same tu / dumneavoastră range, but follow Russian if the caller uses it. Drop Romanian locker brands, bank apps and ANAF.
talk_style_diff.zh: tu／dumneavoastră 層級相同，但對方用俄語就跟。不用羅馬尼亞的櫃點、銀行 App 和 ANAF。

uncertain: Chișinău 等地也常用俄語；本檔 lang 仍依所屬地區用羅馬尼亞語，並在習慣中註明要跟著對方切換。
Nova Poshta 等民營取件點也常見，但主要官方來源是 Poșta Moldovei，故未把單一民營品牌寫成必用詞。
